Added a Story Quest Review feature for affection story quests. After completing a 5-heart affection story quest, players will receive a review item via in-game mail. items.text: Dear Islanders,

Since the launch of the Homestead Layout Design Contest, we've received so much amazing support and creativity from everyone! At the same time, we also received many requests to extend the submission period.
To give everyone more time to finish and polish their dream homesteads, we've decided to make the following schedule adjustments:
May 31, 8:59 AM (PT)
(Originally ending on May 18)
Apr 27, 7:00 PM – May 31, 8:59 AM (PT)
May 31, 7:00 PM – Jun 14, 8:59 AM (PT)

Over the next few weeks, we'll continue sharing more blueprint showcases, building inspiration, and community activities across our social channels and community spaces. We hope everyone continues building and creating their ideal island life together
